reference: The director said they would film the office scene before lunch.
sk: Režisér povedal, že kancelársku scénu natočia pred obedom.
cz: Režisér řekl, že kancelářskou scénu natočí před obědem.
acceptable: The director said {that |}they would {film|shoot} the office scene before lunch.

mistakes.text: The director said {that |}they will {film|shoot} the office scene before lunch.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „said“ sa „will“ v Reported speech zvyčajne mení na „would“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „said“ se „will“ v Reported speech obvykle mění na „would“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “said”, Reported speech usually changes “will” to “would”.

mistakes.text: The director said {that |}they filmed the office scene before lunch.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Filmed“ znamená, že už natočili; budúci plán vyjadruje „would film“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Filmed“ znamená, že už natočili; budoucí plán vyjadřuje „would film“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Filmed” means it already happened; for a future plan in the past use “would film”.

mistakes.text: The director said {that |}they would {filmed|filming} the office scene before lunch.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „would“ patrí holý tvar slovesa: „would film“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „would“ následuje holý tvar slovesa: „would film“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “would” use the bare verb: “would film”.

mistakes.text: The director said {that |}they were going to film the office scene before lunch.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Tu sa cvičí „would“ ako budúcnosť v Reported speech: „would film“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Tady se procvičuje „would“ jako budoucnost v Reported speech: „would film“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises “would” as the future in Reported speech: “would film”.

mistakes.text: The director told {that |}they would film the office scene before lunch.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Tell“ potrebuje osobu („told me“); bez osoby použi „said“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Tell“ potřebuje osobu („told me“); bez osoby použij „said“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Tell” needs a person (“told me”); without one, use “said”.
